title: Academic Structure Fixture (one pilot's primary AY)
description:
Schema for each pilot's academic-structure.json under packages/pilot-fixtures/pilots/<pilot-id>/. Describes the primary academic year's term/exam-window structure plus the cross-year-handoff markers in the NEXT AY (result-publish + new-session-begin + provisional window) that the C9 cross-year sprint will operationalize.

Dates are BS strings (YYYY/MM/DD), zero-padded. Term IDs are kebab-case slugs cross-referenced by the calendar/*.json fixture files (C1.2) — term-1, term-2, etc.

Schema-orthogonal invariants enforced in the spec (not at the schema level):
  - terms are ordered by startBsDate ascending
  - term.startBsDate < term.endBsDate
  - examWindow falls within the term's date range
  - cross-year-marker dates fall in the next AY
  - per-term inclusive day count matches the dossier

academicYearId.description: Slug identifier (e.g. 'ay-2083'). Cross-referenced by metadata.json's primaryAcademicYearId.

calendarSystem.description: Pinned per AY for clarity. Pilots using bikram_sambat express all dates as BS strings.

startBsDate.description: AY first day in BS YYYY/MM/DD.

endBsDate.description: AY last day in BS YYYY/MM/DD.

terms.description: Ordered list of terms within this AY. Must have at least 1.

crossYearMarkers.description: Dates in the NEXT AY that drive Sprint C9's provisional-enrollment handoff. The provisional window is the operational gap between next-AY day-1 (when students are provisionally enrolled in the next grade) and result-publish (when retention decisions land + provisional flips to confirmed).

notes.description: Operator-facing notes. Not consumed by code.

BsDate.description: BS YYYY/MM/DD, zero-padded month and day.

examType.description: Kind of exam this window holds. C7 result-aggregation can branch on examType (e.g., terminal exam triggers cross-year provisional flip per C9.5).

name.description: Optional display name. Falls back to id.

nextAcademicYearId.description: Slug of the AY that this AY rolls into (e.g. 'ay-2084' for ay-2083).

resultPublishBsDate.description: BS date in the NEXT AY when the prior AY's final-exam results publish. C9.5 fires the provisional → confirmed enrollment flip on this date.

newSessionBeginBsDate.description: BS date in the NEXT AY when formal classes start. Usually a few days after resultPublishBsDate.

provisionalWindow.description: The window where students are PROVISIONALLY enrolled in their next-grade but the prior-AY results haven't published yet. C9 implements the state machine that flips them to 'enrolled' or 'retained' once results land.
